review_type: Assistant inspection of development fixtures, not human participant data
findings: Selection cases distinguish accurately reporting forbidden test-based selection from claiming that selection was compliant.

Metric values checked against confusion totals; corruption changes one score and can create an internal ranking inconsistency. Report-only auditors may exploit that cue, which is an intended diagnostic, not proof of evidence use.
Completeness cases distinguish missing runs from low/negative improvements; mean-threshold cases apply the explicit 0.02 rule.
Evaluation-ledger improvements are seeded synthetic inputs, not measured performance of trained classifiers.
limitations: One implementer performed this review. No independent human reviewer or real-model behavior has been assessed.
Held-out variants remain within the same synthetic task families.
